set.excerpt: Typical minimum admission grades ranges (out of 42 subject points; guideline only). Arts: no specific prerequisites, 33 to 36. Management: HL Mathematics (AA or AI) or SL Mathematics AA with 6 or 7; 35 to 38; Math 5 (HL) / 6 (SL AA). Engineering: Mathematics, Chemistry and Physics at HL or SL (at least one math/science at HL); Mechanical Engineering 38 to 42, each math & science 6. Science: Mathematics and two of Biology, Chemistry or Physics, at least one math/science at HL; Physical, Earth, Math and Computer Sciences Group 35 to 38, each math & science 5 to 6 (and at least one 6). The Diploma with grades of 5 or better on each Higher and Standard Level subject is the minimum expected for most programs. Science PREREQUISITES Mathematics and two of Biology, Chemistry or Physics, at Higher or Standard Level; at least one math/science at HL Note : SL Math AI is not accepted. Biological, Biomedical and Life Sciences Group Predicted/Final (out of 42) : 36 to 39 subject points

Typical minimum admission grades ranges (guideline only; minimum grades fluctuate year to year). Arts: minimum of three A-Levels in three different subjects, no specific prerequisites, AAA to ABB. Management: three A-Levels including A-Level Math, A*AA - AAB. Engineering: three A-Levels including at least two of A-Level Math, chemistry, or physics; Mechanical Engineering A*A*A - AAA. Science: three A-Levels including A-Level Math and at least one of biology, chemistry, or physics; Physical, Earth, Math and Computer Sciences Group A*AA - ABB. Minimum of three A-Levels in three different subjects, including A-Level Math and at least one A-Level in biology, chemistry, or physics; Biology, chemistry, math and physics at GCSE level Biological, Biomedical and Life Sciences Group Predicted/Final A-Levels: A*AA - AAB

Typical Admission Grades Ranges: Arts - B+ average (unweighted) in each of grades 11 and 12, B+ in each English, ACT 27-29 or SAT EB Read & Writing 670-700. Management - prerequisites English, pre-calculus; B+ to A- average, B+ in each prerequisite math, A- in each English, ACT 29-31 or SAT EBRW 690-700, Math 690-710. Engineering - prerequisites pre-calculus, chemistry and physics; A- to A average (varies by program). Science, Physical, Earth, Math and Computer Sciences Group - B+ to A- average, A- in each prerequisite math and science, ACT 29-31 or SAT EBRW 690-700, Math 690-710. Courses must include: Pre-calculus; two of biology, chemistry or physics Biological, Biomedical and Life Sciences Group Bio-Physical-Computational Sciences Group Physical, Earth, Math and Computer Sciences Group B+ to A- average (unweighted) in each of grades 11 and 12 A- in each prerequisite math and science ACT 29-31; or SAT: EB Read & Writing 690-700, Math 690-710
